To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) top k documents are not necessarily the best for feedback; (2) presenting a diversified set of documents for feedback can significantly improve the effectiveness of relevance feedback; and (3) the k-cluster centroid method is a promising approach for active feedback.
(1) The k-cluster centroid method is the best method for active feedback; (2) The gapped top-k method is the second best; (3) The top-k method is not as good as the two other methods.
(i) top-k is not as beneficial as k-cluster centroid; (ii) the gapped-top-k method is more beneficial than the top-k method, and (iii) k-cluster centroid is more beneficial than gapped-top-k
